title: 苹果Home的AI摄像头功能能否超越亚马逊和谷歌？实测对比
summary: 本文是The Verge的一篇评测文章，作者通过亲身测试，对比了苹果Home的AI摄像头功能与亚马逊Ring、谷歌Nest的智能家居安防系统。文章以作者在海滩复活节寻蛋活动中的经历开篇，当时他收到安全摄像头的“检测到运动”通知，但未及时查看。评测旨在探究苹果的AI摄像头功能是否能在智能识别、通知精准度和用户体验上超越竞争对手。通过实际使用，作者分析了各平台在AI驱动下的安防表现，包括物体检测、通知过滤和隐私保护等方面。文章为消费者提供了智能家居安防选择的参考，并探讨了AI在家庭监控领域的应用前景。
summary_en: This article from The Verge is a review that compares Apple Home's AI camera features with Amazon Ring and Google Nest's smart home security systems through hands-on testing. The author begins with a personal anecdote about receiving a 'motion detected' notification from his security camera during a beachside Easter egg hunt, which he ignored. The review aims to determine whether Apple's AI camera features can outperform competitors in intelligent recognition, notification accuracy, and user experience. Through practical use, the author analyzes each platform's AI-driven security performance, including object detection, notification filtering, and privacy protection. The article provides a reference for consumers choosing smart home security and explores the future of AI in home monitoring.
